issues.legal_issue: A limitation issue that requires factual determinations cannot be tried as a preliminary issue in a civil suit.
material_facts: The plaintiff sought to invalidate settlement deeds made by a former trustee in favour of family members and to recover the property for a religious trust.
Whether the property qualified as trust property within the meaning of Section 10 of the Limitation Act, and whether the transfers were for valuable consideration, had not been determined.
The trial court treated limitation as a preliminary issue and dismissed the suit, and the appellate court affirmed that dismissal.
issues.conclusion: The limitation issue involved mixed questions of fact and law and could not be decided as a preliminary issue. The Court set aside the judgments below without expressing any opinion on whether the suit was ultimately barred by limitation.
issues.legal_principle: Under Order 14 Rule 2 of the Code of Civil Procedure, an issue involving factual inquiry cannot be tried as a preliminary issue; a preliminary issue must be capable of disposal on a question of law alone and must concern jurisdiction or a statutory bar. A limitation plea is ordinarily a mixed question of fact and law because its determination may require facts to establish when limitation begins. The Court relied on Major S.S. Khanna v. Brig. F.J. Dillon, Ramesh D. Desai v. Bipin Vadilal Mehta, and Ramrameshwari Devi v. Nirmala Devi. Section 10 of the Limitation Act protects qualifying trust property from limitation, while Articles 92 and 96 concern transfers for valuable consideration; whether those provisions applied depended on facts not yet determined.

predicates.civil_suit: The proceeding is a civil suit in which the court is asked to decide the parties’ claims.
predicates.limitation_requires_factual_inquiry: Deciding whether the suit is time-barred requires resolving facts, rather than applying law to facts already established.

issues.definition: When a civil suit presents a limitation issue that requires factual inquiry, that issue is not decided as a preliminary issue.
